mapper.insert: INSERT INTO registered_accounts ( fintech_use_num, user_seq_no, bank_code, bank_name, account_num, account_holder_name, balance_amt, available_amt, created_at ) VALUES ( #{fintechUseNum}, #{userSeqNo}, #{bankCode}, #{bankName}, #{accountNum}, #{accountHolderName}, #{balanceAmt}, #{availableAmt}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT fintech_use_num, user_seq_no, bank_code, bank_name, account_num, account_holder_name, balance_amt, available_amt, created_at FROM registered_accounts WHERE fintech_use_num = #{fintechUseNum}
